answer: Proposal: weight by locked, slashable stake, plus a small fixed bond per account. Reward and voting weight are proportional to stake locked all epoch; any peer's fraud proof burns it. Splitting one hoard into n accounts then costs n bonds for the same total weight — a river forked into channels carries no more water. More influence means buying more stake; proven fraud burns it, so clones gain nothing. Limit: this prices out sybils, not plutocrats — a timber magnate can still buy the oasis. Assumes peers honestly verify fraud and the ledger enforces slashing.
